title: Suffix Swap
statement: Implement `solve(path, new_suffix)`. `path` is a POSIX path. Replace the final suffix, including the dot, with `new_suffix`. `new_suffix` includes the leading dot when you want one. A name with no suffix gains `new_suffix`. Return the path string. Do not change directories.
constraints: new_suffix may be an empty string, which removes the suffix
hints: Split off the last slash so the directory is untouched.

If the filename contains a dot and is not a dotfile with no further dot, replace from the last dot. A leading-dot name like .gitignore has no suffix to replace. Treat a name that starts with a dot and has no other dot as having no suffix.
Append or replace, then rejoin the directory.
editorial: pathlib.Path.with_suffix replaces the last suffix and leaves the parent. A string replace of .txt can hit a directory name. Operating on the final segment only is the safe version of the same idea.
